change_summary: Drop the re-sent system prompt/policy after the first assistant turn in build_messages, keeping full history but avoiding redundant per-turn system tokens.
reason_for_change: The costliest tasks (103 @ 34 turns, 99 @ 31 turns, 109 @ 31 turns) scale cost with turn count because build_messages replays the full system prompt on every call. Since the policy has already been consumed once the assistant has responded, re-sending it each turn is redundant input tokens. Sending it only on turn 1 removes system-token overhead that multiplies by turn count, lowering mean/total cost most on exactly the high-turn tasks, while retaining full history so task success is preserved.
reason_accepted_or_rejected: rejected: first proxy run did not improve — crossed success guardrail: pass_rate 0.5000 < floor 0.5410
hypothesis: Passing the full system prompt on every turn is redundant; compressing older history and/or dropping the re-sent policy after turn 1 reduces cumulative input tokens on high-turn tasks.
